summary: Iteration 4 — Verified RBAC (dev cannot delete), dev license creation, pricing method FIFO/WAVG with cost_layers, deliveries with unit=PACKAGE, distributor REST endpoints, revoked-token flow and auth name cache. Backend 36/36 PASS (20 new iteration-4 tests + 16 regression). (7) POST /api/dev/licenses returns 200 with LIC-prefixed code & READY status; non-dev callers rejected. (6) DELETE /api/auth/account as dev → 400 with 'المطور ...صلاحية'; PATCH /api/dev/deletion-requests/x action=approve → 400 'حذف الحسابات متاح للمالك والموظفين فقط'; action=reject passes role check (404 'الطلب غير موجود'). (3) PUT /api/org/pricing-method rejects BOGUS, rejects non-owner; FIFO + new unit_cost=700 creates ≥2 cost_layers while cost_price stays at oldest (500); purchase-return consumes oldest layer; switching to WAVG and buying at 800 clears cost_layers and blends cost_price. (4) POST /api/deliveries with unit=PACKAGE on product 504c618ff... (ppp=10) deducts 10 from owner warehouse stock; agent confirm adds 10 to distributor_inventory. (1) GET /api/notifications and /api/targets return 200 for agent; invalid token → 401. UI (390x844): all 4 roles land on correct routes (/owner /acct /dist /dev) with NO error boundary, NO Unmatched Route. Agent cached_user localStorage key contains name='موزع الاختبار'. Revoked token (bogus_token_xyz) + reload → redirected to /login cleanly, no crash. Dev account sheet (account-button) exposes logout-button but NO delete-account-button (RBAC). Dev licenses tab shows add-license-button and lists existing licences (TEST_UILIC_1791854104 + TEST_lic visible); creating a new license showed Arabic toast 'تم إنشاء الترخيص ✓'. Owner account sheet exposes delete-account-button alongside logout-button. Owner > الإدارة > ملف المؤسسة tab exposes pricing-method-picker, pricing-method-fifo, pricing-method-wavg, save-pricing-method-button, request-deletion-button (all count=1). DID NOT confirm actual deletion for owner/dev/agent/acct test accounts.
critical_code_review_comments: convex/extra.ts devDeletionReview throws 'الطلب غير موجود' with 404 status — fine, but a stricter test could pre-check role regardless of action so dev gets 403 for both approve and reject before resource lookup. Low priority.
src/auth.tsx line 162-164 writes cached_user whenever user state changes — exactly what the PR requested. Verified live for FIELD_AGENT.
